shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A man in a red shirt sits at the pinboard-side window seat and argues that true accomplishment requires multiple skills. A man in a green shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat, and a woman in an orange shirt sits at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in a green shirt leaves the entrance-side window seat and exits the seminar room. The man in a red shirt asks if such a demanding standard is realistic.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a red shirt remarks that genuine qualification is exceedingly rare.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.
